newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy basis broadly steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy basis broadly steady.

text.p: FOB Gulf corn and soybean basis values were broadly steady on Tuesday.
Dealers said the slow pace of farmer sales of both corn and soybeans continued to underpin values.

They noted news that Taiwan's CK Group of importers bought one 54,000-tonne shipment of U.S. corn for 87.99 U.S. cents over CBOT March futures. Shipment was slated for the second half of January if from U.S. Gulf.
The Philippines' purchase of 150,000 tonnes of U.S. corn was also a background supportive factor.
FOB wheat offers were steady in very quiet conditions.
